payload.text: hv by AskUserQuestion in vc's window, read by 2026-11-27 08:42Z by date -u, each hv's choice of vc's recommended option, on the close-out of decision 335. For devbin, vc pushes main to local and upstream after its close-out. hv did not correct vc's two readings put with the question: an item with no work done also moves into a future, unstarted ST or WP (which replaces decision 46's "every open item is an issue" for devbin), and the Desk puts the focus projects first.
